meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 装上后,用户要求审查已完成的工作时,Claude 会并行启动 5 个后台子代理:核对目标与约束、检查代码质量、审计安全、实际运行应用做 QA、挖掘 GitHub/git/Slack/Notion 等上下文。5 项全过才通过,任一失败即整体失败。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发,比如说 'review work'、'QA my work'、'verify implementation' 等。

say.text: 请 review 我这次改的代码,重点核对是否实现了原始目标和要求。
say.note: 会并行启动 5 个子代理分头审查。

say.text: 在交接 PR 之前,审查当前分支的代码质量和安全性。
say.note: 包含代码审查与安全审计两个子代理。

say.text: QA 一下我的实现,实际运行应用,检查功能是否正常。
say.note: QA 子代理会实际跑应用做验证。

howto.what_en: When asked to review completed work, Claude launches 5 parallel sub-agents: goal/constraint check, code quality, security audit, hands-on QA run, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass; one failure fails the review.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review done work, e.g. saying 'review work', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', etc.

say_en.text: Please review my changes and verify they meet the original goal.
Review the current branch's code quality and security before PR handoff.
say_en.note: Covers code review and a security audit.

say_en.text: QA my implementation — run the app and check it works.
say_en.note: The QA sub-agent actually runs the app.
